scientific_limitations: Real one-dimensional periodic BV and positive integer powers q>=2; no higher-dimensional, weighted, complex-valued, simultaneous q,n asymptotics or global metric stability. The finite-degree norm and arc rigidity are derived analytically; finite tests are corroborative only. Historical priority remains tentative in view of older undigitized approximation research.
source_date_integrity: The earliest precisely day-dated public source in the selected archival references is the March 20, 2013 journal release. A university report R-2010-01 is independently identified as published in 2010, but its public calendar day is not verified; the 2013 field is not a claim of the first existence of the research.
title: Sharp BV approximation and parity-order rigidity for powered Fejér–Jackson kernels
